changes.comment: Additive weighted pick: pure `pickWeightedAt(unit, candidates)` with `IWeightedCandidate<T>`, and `PseudoRandomGenerator.pickWeighted(candidates)` over `nextFloat()`. Only finite positive weights are eligible, `unit` is accepted on `[0, 1]`, and the walk (input order, `point < cumulative`, last by elimination) is fixed so persisted draws stay stable.
